opening.argument: The pitch presents a ten-token StrongBlock node as producing three tokens monthly and recovering the investment, even though the displayed node page identifies the contribution as non-refundable. It also markets Wonderland through an extremely high-yield claim and solicits paid monthly membership with the claim that higher-tier spaces are running out. Together, these return claims and scarcity pressure establish a deceptive investment solicitation, despite the included warnings about high APYs and severe losses.
